verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains generic API access claims and feature descriptions but no specific mention of data retention policies, candidate data deletion endpoints, GDPR 'right to be forgotten' tooling, or retention period configuration. 'Full control over your data' (workable-docs-18) is a vague API framing, not evidence of retention/deletion controls. Missing for 10: documented deletion API/endpoint, retention policy settings, GDPR compliance tooling, data purge schedules.
